Marlpit Grocers opens a delivery depot in Norwich

NORWICH, 2 February 2026 – Marlpit Grocers today opened a delivery depot in Norwich, its first outside Ipswich.

"We chose Norwich because most of our customers already live within an hour of the city," said Elin Carrow, founder of Marlpit Grocers.

"Our vans now reach 140 villages that had no grocery delivery before," said Tomas Reid, operations lead.

"We will launch a Saturday delivery service for every village on our routes," said Elin Carrow.

"We'll have the new office open within eight weeks," said Tomas Reid.

"We're thrilled to bring this innovative solution to our valued customers," said Elin Carrow.

About Marlpit Grocers
Marlpit Grocers is a fictional company. It is used here only as test text.
